notes.title: UPDATE: DEMO Ver 1.8
notes.notes:
Updated character avatars.
Enhanced the balance of the combat system and improved the AI of both enemies and allies.
Adjusted the storyline of some levels and added new content.
When picking up dropped items from enemies, they won't disappear if the player reaches the maximum capacity, allowing time for adjustment.
Redesigned the treasure chest system, optimizing item categorization and quantity control.
Bug fixes and overall improvements.

notes.title: Monstronium Demo Ver 1.55 Update
notes.notes:
Dear friends, 


 Adjusted player hit box: Spin Sword attack (charge attack) is no longer OP.
 Mary's attack hit box adjuested and power re-balanced (still powerful, but...)
 Adjusted some bosses.
 New attack move set for a mini boss.
 Fixed a bug where follower's HP is not updated on screen in real time. 
 Fixed a bug in the 'Ally Auto Heal' function, where if your ally's HP is already below 33% when it is turned on, it will only work after you switch character once. It is fixed now. 
 The game difficulty level option is now affecting enemy's HP as well as their other powers.
If you set the difficult level below 100% (middle), you will not gain any EXP by killing monsters.
You can change this setting anytime. This is still a test for this demo only. 
 Added a few navigation waypoints to the map.
 Original music work.
 Other minor fixes and changes.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jRMl3e_vTAE

Thank you and have a nice day!

notes.title: Monstronium Demo Ver 1.5 Update
notes.notes:
Dear friends, 

Here are some of the changes that have been made into the latest version of this demo:


 Changed many SFX from RTP placeholder to original materials
 Changed how Mary fight in the Doll House, to avoid a potential soft-locking bug
 Fixed some transportation point detection bugs
 Have access to a workbench early in the game in order to craft rings
 Enemy re-balance adjustment
 Menu function updates (give warning message when discard items, weapons and accessories, etc)
Changed some animation effects


Oh, by the way, the well leads to a castle, that is a good thing to have ;-)

Thank you all!

notes.title: Monstronium Demo Ver 1.4 Update
notes.notes:
Some changes have been made into the game based on feedbacks from our testers.


 Fullscreen works with dual-monitor setup now, allowing mouse to be used in other applications while playing the game

 Some cutscenes are added to the game to give better focus on your mission and not get lost

 A descriptions for each parameter when leveling up, so you know exactly what is affecting what

 Added a little bit more loot to make your life slightly easier ;-)

 Enemy balancing

 Changed some keyboard key bindings, also updated the controller layout image accordingly

 No more 'Marry'




I will keep working on things that will make your gaming experience as intuitive and enjoyable as possible.  Maybe I will make crafting notes visble by player in game menu, I don't know now, because that is kinda unnecessary, since you will only need it when you craft an item that needs it and it will show up for you. I will think a better way to deal with that, maybe.  

Anyway, thank you for your time, have a nice day!

notes.title: Monstronium Demo Ver 1.3 Update
notes.notes:
Hello there, this is a small update for the Monstronium Demo.

Changelog:

Removed the in game full screen setting option.
Now the game uses defult Alt + Enter to switch between fullscreen and windowed mode.

Note that on Steam Deck, this is not affected. As Steam Deck will always in fullscreen mode.
Only use this when you are playing in Windows, and you are not automatically in fullscreen mode.



Thank you and have a nice day!

notes.title: Demo Ver 1.2 Update
notes.notes:
Hello there! 
Monstronium Demo Ver 1.2 is out.

Changes:
 
Tutorial stage now have a dedicated section for "bloking" technique, which is essential for new players.
Some fix and adjustment to tutorial texts, make it more clear and intuitive.
Reduced training droids HP.
Added a mini tutorial for moving objects in Figus's workshop.
Lowered some sound effects for certain enemies.

Thank you!
